reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

Standardizes remaining frontend Tauri IPC call sites to go through the app’s `safeInvoke` wrapper, improving consistency of typing and centralized error handling across Agent + Skills + Settings UI flows.

**Changes:**
- Replaced `safeInvoke as invoke` call sites with direct `safeInvoke<T>(...)` usage across contexts, hooks, and agent/settings feature code.
- Updated agent backend IPC helpers to route calls through `safeInvoke` consistently.
- Added a Hermes journal entry documenting the cleanup of missed `invoke` replacements.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 10 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| src/lib/backend/agent-commands.ts | Switches agent IPC helpers to call `safeInvoke` directly. |
| src/features/settings/tabs/GeneralTab.tsx | Routes skills directory commands through `safeInvoke`. |
| src/features/agent/components/AgentChatStatusBar.tsx | Updates dynamic import usage to `safeInvoke` for session config updates. |
| src/features/agent/api/agent-backend.ts | Routes agent builtin tool calls via `safeInvoke`. |
| src/features/agent/AgentDraftChatView.tsx | Converts agent setup + messaging IPC calls to `safeInvoke`. |
| src/context/llm/useLLMListener.ts | Uses `safeInvoke` when reporting LLM responses/errors back to Rust. |
| src/context/SkillsContext.tsx | Uses `safeInvoke` for skills directory lookup and scanning. |
| src/context/AgentSessionListContext.tsx | Uses `safeInvoke` for session list CRUD/bookmark IPC. |
| src/context/AgentSessionContext.tsx | Uses `safeInvoke` for session load/resume/init/send/approval IPC. |
| src/context/AgentChatContext.tsx | Uses `safeInvoke` for service contexts, inject, send, cancel IPC. |
| .jules/hermes.md | Adds a journal entry describing the remaining replacements. |
</details>
